about: Keyboard handlers without a shortcut dialog, curated from frontend/src on release/3.0.0. Each entry names its source file. The dialog tables come from data/repo.json.

groups.title: Anywhere
rows: Open or close the command palette
Close the Activity panel when it is open and not pinned

groups.title: Query bar
rows: Focus the query bar of the table
Search, or insert the highlighted suggestion
Complete a field or a value
Dismiss the suggestions, or clear the query when none are open
Open the syntax guide, in an empty query bar

groups.title: Result tables
rows: Rescan the selection, in the web assets table
Previous or next host, inside a host in the endpoints table
Leave the host, in the endpoints table
Switch to the Nth tab of a run page or a target page

groups.title: Detail sheets
rows: Switch the tab of the finding detail sheet

groups.title: Compare runs
rows: Open the first change, then the next

groups.title: Editors and dialogs
rows: Save, in the scan engine editor and the scan context editor
Start the scan, in the launch dialog
Save a note, or send a request from the proxy request dialog
Cancel an edit of a note
Send a message in Ask. Shift+Enter adds a line.
